ASIAN AMERICAN CULTURAL CENTER | WEEKLY NEWSLETTER

THIS WEEK
* Senior Story: Kelly Dai and Jen Chen. Tue Nov 17, 5-6pm, AACC MPR.
* Politics of the Purse (fiscal policy simulation). Wed Nov 18, 7-8pm, AACC MPR.
* Grammars of Possibility: Poetry Workshop with Michelle Phuong Ho. Thu Nov 19, 12-1:30pm, AACC MPR.
* WaMH Talk: Culture, Consent, and Care (YC3 student-led affinity space). Thu Nov 19, 4:30-6pm, AACC MPR. Hot Murga catering.

BEFORE BREAK
* Annual AACC November Recess Family Dinner. Mon Nov 23, 4-6pm, AACC.

Heads up: the AACC closes Nov 20 at 4pm and reopens Nov 30.

AACC, 295 Crown St
